title: Proudly, a Free Guide
description: Between 2020 and 2021, I created a modest guide to help a player who PM'd me asking how I climbed the ranks. The result? He went from Platinum to Diamond in less than a month. In 2026, I decided to turn that same foundation into a website, combining my League of Legends experience with my programming journey to help even more people evolve.
card_1_text: Tested and validated strategies by someone who has lived the struggle of climbing the ladder. No fluff.
card_2_text: No corporate jargon or impossible-to-apply analysis. It's the perspective of someone who actually plays and understands solo queue reality.
card_3_text: The focus isn't just giving you a cheat sheet, but teaching you the necessary mindset to keep climbing.
